note: Ownership map as structured data. LAYER A only: concept -> owner doc (+ allowed referencers). Ownership answers 'who owns this concept'; it does not track code. The prose guidance ('edit the owner; link, don't redefine') is GENERIC and lives in the global authoring-rules. Owner/reference paths are relative to docs/.
